beats.summary: Michael explains the significance of St. Patrick's Day in Scranton, comparing it to Christmas for the Irish.

evidence.snippet: Michael: It is St. Patrick's Day, and here in Scranton that is a huge deal. It is the closest that the Irish will ever get to Christmas.
